name: SBA School Management System API
description:
RESTful API for Ghana Education Service (GES) School-Based Assessment management system.

**Features:**
- Dashboard overview with real-time stats
- Assessment creation and score entry
- Class and subject management
- Curriculum standards mapping
- Report card generation
